actions.name: import_meeting
actions.description: Import a meeting from a URL. Import a meeting, recording, or other media from a URL. The URL must be publicly accessible, and the media must be in a supported format.

name.description: The name of the meeting/recording imported

url.description: The url of the meeting/recording imported. Important: the url must be publicly accessible and the media must be in a supported format. Supported formats are: .mp3, .mp4, .wav, .m4a, .mkv, .mov, .avi, .wma, .flac.

happenedAt.description: The date of the meeting/recording. If not provided, the current date will be used

dryRun.description: For testing purposes: whether to run the import as a dry run. If true, the import will not be persisted to the database, and nothing will be run.

participants.description: An array of emails of the invited participants to the meeting/recording

phoneNumber.description: A phone number associated with the meeting/recording, e.g. the other party of a phone call. It is stored and returned verbatim on the meeting (GET /meetings/{id}) and in the MeetingReady webhook.Max 64 characters.

metadata.description: Flat key/value object with your own identifiers (record ids, call ids, ...) so you can correlate the meeting when it comes back on GET /meetings/{id} and in the MeetingReady webhook. Values are stored and returned verbatim. Limits: at most 20 keys; keys must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; values must be strings of at most 256 characters, numbers or booleans. Nested objects and arrays are not accepted.

actions.name: get_meeting_transcript
actions.description: Get transcript by meeting id. Get the transcript of a meeting by its id. The transcript is returned in a human readable format. The transcript is returned only if it is complete

meetingId.description: The meeting's id; list_meetings lists them (also the last part of its tldv.io link)

actions.name: get_meeting_notes
actions.description: Get notes by meeting id. Get the notes of a meeting by its id. The notes are returned in a human readable format

meetingId.description: The meeting's id; list_meetings lists them (also the last part of its tldv.io link)

page.description: The page number to return. Default is 1

limit.description: The number of results to return per page. Default is 50. Max is 100. The total number of results cannot exceed 10,000. If this limit is exceeded, refine the date range or period.

onlyParticipated.description: Whether to only return meetings the user participated in. Default is false

meetingType.description: Filters meetings by type: internal (all participants from the same organization) or external (includes at least one participant from another organization). Defaults to both if not provided

folderIds.description: Folder ids. Only meetings in these folders are returned. Repeat the parameter or separate ids with commas. Combine them with folderIdsOp.

folderIdsOp.description: How to combine folderIds. Omit it to match any folder. Pass and to require every folder.

actions.name: get_meeting
actions.description: Get a meeting by its id. The meeting is returned in a human readable format

meetingId.description: The meeting's id; list_meetings lists them (also the last part of its tldv.io link)

actions.name: download_meeting_recording
actions.description:
Download the meeting recording file. Returns an HTTP redirect to a signed, expiring download URL for the meeting recording.

**Redirect behavior**:
- Most HTTP clients follow the redirect automatically and start downloading the file.
- If you disable redirect following, read the `Location` header to obtain the signed URL.

**Signed URL TTL**: The signed URL expires 6 hours after issuance.

meetingId.description: The meeting's id; list_meetings lists them (also the last part of its tldv.io link)

actions.name: search_folders
actions.description: Search folders the API key user can see. Search by name, or pass meeting ids to find the folders that contain those meetings. Omit the operator to match any meeting. Pass and to require every meeting. The meetings list stays a separate call: pass a folder id to GET /meetings.

query.description: A folder name to search for. Matching includes the Japanese phrase match used by meeting titles.

meetingIds.description: Meeting ids the folder must contain. Repeat the parameter or separate ids with commas. Combine them with meetingIdsOp.

meetingIdsOp.description: How to combine meetingIds. Omit it to match any meeting. Pass and to require every meeting.

space.description: Which folders to search. all includes personal, team, and organization folders. Omit it to search all of them.

page.description: The page number to return. Default is 1

limit.description: The number of results to return per page. Default is 50. Max is 100.

actions.name: start_recording_upload
actions.description:
Initiate a recording upload (beta). > **Beta.** Recording uploads are in beta and are enabled on request. To get access, contact support@tldv.io.
> Until your user is enabled, these endpoints answer `404`.

Start uploading a recording from your own system. Declare the exact file size and the meeting details, and
receive the part plan with a signed upload URL per part.

Uploading a recording is a three-step process:

1. **Initiate** (`POST /meetings/upload`): declare the exact file size and the meeting details. The response is a
   plan: the file is split into numbered parts, each with the byte range to send and a signed URL to send it to.
2. **Upload the parts**: for each part, `PUT` the ...

name.description: The name of the meeting/recording that will be created from the upload

sizeBytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes. The part plan and the signed upload URLs are derived from it, so it must match the file byte for byte: a part whose body does not have the planned length is rejected by the storage. Maximum 2 GiB (2,147,483,648 bytes); larger files are rejected with `413`.

fileName.description: Original file name, kept for reference only

contentType.description: MIME type of the file when known. Supported families: video/*, audio/*, application/octet-stream. The media is validated again during processing regardless of this value.

happenedAt.description: The date of the meeting/recording. If not provided, the current date will be used

participants.description: An array of emails of the invited participants to the meeting/recording

phoneNumber.description: A phone number associated with the meeting/recording, e.g. the other party of a phone call. It is stored and returned verbatim on the meeting (GET /meetings/{id}) and in the MeetingReady webhook. Max 64 characters.

metadata.description: Flat key/value object with your own identifiers (record ids, call ids, ...) so you can correlate the meeting when it comes back on GET /meetings/{id} and in the MeetingReady webhook. Values are stored and returned verbatim. Limits: at most 20 keys; keys must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; values must be strings of at most 256 characters, numbers or booleans. Nested objects and arrays are not accepted.

actions.name: get_recording_upload
actions.description:
Get the status of a recording upload (beta). > **Beta.** Enabled on request; see *Initiate a recording upload* for how to get access.

Returns the part plan with, for each part, whether the storage already holds it. Parts still missing come
with a fresh signed URL, so this is the call to make to resume an interrupted upload or after a URL expired.
`status` tells whether the upload is still pending or was completed; the import job id is present either way.

actions.name: abort_recording_upload
actions.description:
Abort a recording upload (beta). > **Beta.** Enabled on request; see *Initiate a recording upload* for how to get access.

Discards an upload that will not be completed: the parts already stored are dropped. Aborting an upload that
already expired or was aborted is a no-op.

actions.name: complete_recording_upload
actions.description:
Complete a recording upload (beta). > **Beta.** Enabled on request; see *Initiate a recording upload* for how to get access.

Call once every part has been uploaded to complete the upload.

Safe to retry: calling it again for a completed upload returns the same job id. If parts are missing the
answer is `409` with their numbers; upload them and call complete again.
